record_type: Audit summary transcribed from completed CTest logs and reproduced regression failures; optical reports are generated by C++20 executables.

fixes.finding: A .ppm output path caused the preview to overwrite its JSON report.
fixes.before: Regression failed: command returned success and overwrote a pre-existing display.
fixes.after: Output requires .json; invalid path preserves the prior file and produces no manifest.

fixes.finding: Refined nonterminal events bypassed null-ceiling enforcement and maximum-residual reporting.
fixes.after: Refined events reject the entire trial when over the null ceiling; published crossings update diagnostics. The failed endpoint is retained for diagnosis.

fixes.finding: Empty Bernstein polynomial input dereferenced an empty range.
fixes.after: Explicit invalid_argument; canonical valid shell certificates still pass.

tests.scope: Optical reference, full optics CLI/image regression test, and reference arithmetic/polynomials; not the complete suite.

historical_report_caveat: Pre-fix ray reports can understate maximum null residual by excluding nonterminal refined crossings. Preserve their source digests; do not relabel them as current validation.
limitations: Bounded code/test audit, not proof of correctness for every input or trajectory.
The full 128x96 pilots were not rerun; refreshed image comparisons use 16x12 pixel centers.
No new ray-domain coverage, GYOTO comparison, whole-image acceptance or stability claim.
Same host and libstdc++; test times include overlapping verification and are not benchmarks.
